newsitem.title: USA: Southern mineral says sells 2.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Southern mineral says sells 2.5 mln shares.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp said it sold 2.5 million shares of its common stock in a private placement to institutional investors at $4.50 a share.

The company said it will use the proceeds from the offering -- about $10.6 million -- to reduce bank debt, fund the cost of future exploration and development projects and for general corporate purposes.
Morgan Keegan & Co acted as placement agent, Southern Mineral said. The company had about 6,588,519 common shares outstanding before the placement, it said.
